name: AI Mode Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Configure and control Falcon Player (FPP) using natural language via major AI platforms. Link OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, Grok, OpenRouter, Ollama (local, not installed by default) and more with API tokens to create playlists, schedules, channel outputs and settings from typed prompts. Includes conversational assistant with tool-calling execution with approval and full FPP API coverage.

privacy.other: API keys are stored in plugindata with 0600 and are never logged. Chat, Test Connection and model-list routes send your prompt, chat history and FPP context to the provider you selected, only when you use those features; Save, Execute, conversation and history routes change or delete your own data, and Flag FPPD Restart asks FPP to restart. These routes are reached exactly like FPP's own pages and have no separate login, so they check that a browser request came from the same FPP host. Updates, reinstalls and uninstalls are left to FPP's Plugin Manager.
